sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) [GM2-05] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (werdenfels).
Our order history for this part shows 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) against 5.84 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014427-10).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).
Today you supply 20 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,700 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and are pleased to accept the AS-14404 index clause and 45-day payment terms from your second option.
In response to your reference to our previous order history, we are prepared to reduce our price to €5.60 per unit.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not disclose internal cost structures.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
Our management has reviewed your request and the proposed binding volume of 23,700 kg per year.
Before we can fully factor this volume into our calculation, we must ask you to share the underlying data for this figure.
In response to your movement, we can offer a reduced price of €5.50 per unit on the 45-day payment terms.
Which volume can you commit to?
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
